findings.risk: Authenticated facts must survive failure before or after each logical effect and restart, without depending on another GitHub delivery.
implementation: Migration 1341 adds dedicated tenant-scoped verified receipts with payload/hash and installation/repository/event/action binding, per-step outcome checkpoints, persisted metric-to-flow batches, attempt count, due time and error class.

Ingress bounds the body to 2 MiB and five seconds, validates HMAC, unique keys, supported event/action, typed envelope and configured binding, then commits the receipt before any step/network work. Signatures and HTTP headers are not persisted. Reuse of a delivery id with different authenticated content returns 409.
Projection, fanout, check_audit, merge_audit, metrics, flow and completion run in order. Each successful or explicit no-op outcome is checkpointed; already completed steps are skipped.

Session advisory claims serialize a receipt across replicas and requests without row locks spanning network reads. Tenant fences remain in the final receipt writes. Restart releases the session claim; the stored crash due time preserves unfinished work.

The module worker scans at most 20 due receipts with a five-second database deadline and a four-minute pass bound. Failed work becomes eligible after five seconds, doubling to a five-minute backoff cap; reconciliation may delay a pass. Pending facts are not discarded on retry exhaustion.

Existing logical-effect keys/upserts are retained. The legacy reconciliation fanout scan excludes durable receipts so it cannot race the new chain. Failed writes remain visible 502 responses with content-free step/error-class logs.

Missing/partial canonical merge proof and refused completion remain pending with backoff and earlier checkpoints retained. Recovery rechecks the original ownership/human gates; confirmed constituents converge independently without duplicate completion events.

regressions.cases: Seven steps, each with a pre-effect fault and an effect-committed/checkpoint-failed fault (14 cases). Failures are injected at real upstream or database boundaries. A fresh module recovers from the same store by invoking only the internal due-page worker.
assertions: Failure leaves attempts=1, the correct failed step/error class, no completed checkpoint for that step and next_attempt_at exactly five seconds later.
Injected-clock retry before due time has no effect; the due retry finishes attempts=2 with all seven checkpoints and cleared failure state.
The selected logical effect exists exactly once after retry. Retained bypass-merge and Flow event counts do not grow across the respective checkpoint failure.
A completed metrics checkpoint supplies the saved batch without another Actions read when downstream flow/completion retries.
Another due pass and same-content redelivery do not add effects; backoff growth and cap are asserted.

A barrier proves the receipt exists before projection's network read. A second replica cannot claim it, altered signed content returns 409, unsigned input stores nothing, and another tenant sees no receipt.
regressions.method: Barriers and injected clocks, immutable run timestamps; timeouts only guard hangs. Fanout's idempotent sink is modeled with a committed unique key, not invocation counts.
regressions.runtime: PASS on final integrated source 656c97c98: full remote delivery suite (60.943s), all 14 pre/post-effect cases and receipt-integrity/claim case included; no failed or skipped fix4 regression reported.
regressions.pending_completion: Existing TestMergeDoneQueueConstituentsRequireActualMerge and TestMergeDoneRefusalNeedsYouAndRecovery retain their assertions and now also require internal-worker recovery before redelivery. Partial canonical proof leaves the unconfirmed subject pending and produces exactly two logical completion events after both are confirmed. Both strengthened cases PASS in the full 6cf02b54c suite. Both cases also PASS in the final 656c97c98 suite.

findings.risk: A PR discovered by reconciliation has a blank scalar ledger head but must still consume a delayed empty-subject suite for an observed historical head.
findings.implementation: suiteNeedsFlow matches bounded historical observations by head_sha or queue_head independently of the scalar ledger head_sha and resolves those observations against current repository/ticket-linked consumers. The history page is limited to 101 rows, observations to 100 per row and the database lookup to five seconds.
findings.regression: TestDeliveryWebhookUnlinkedMetricSource/reconciled_then_synchronized_delayed_empty_suite: discover through Reconcile without any opening webhook, synchronize the head, then deliver an empty-subject suite for the old head; retain the Actions read and linked Flow fact without metric rows.
findings.runtime: PASS in the full final remote delivery suite on 656c97c98 (60.943s). The reconciliation-only historical-head and saturated-history/current-link-removal cases are both included.

findings.risk: Saturated historic observations must not revive a consumer after every current ticket link is removed.
findings.implementation: The history-overflow predicate is inside the EXISTS over current repository-scoped delivery_items with both project_id and ticket_node_id. Overflow only conservatively requests Actions data while such a consumer exists.
findings.regression: TestDeliveryWebhookUnlinkedMetricSource/saturated_history_all_links_removed: saturate history beyond the 100-row bound, remove all current links, make Actions unavailable, and assert 204 with zero Actions reads and no metric/Flow facts.
